title: CalibrationRequest
description: POST /save/calibration and POST /preview/calibration body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; shown here as the values before encoding). Omitted fields keep their value, out-of-range values are clamped. /save/calibration saves the layout, sets `num_leds` to the sum of the sides and shows the calibration preview; /preview/calibration only shows the preview. Replies with Esp32Message.

clockwise.description: Strip direction from the start corner: 1 = clockwise, 0 = counter-clockwise (GET /config `clockwise`).
